Paranodal loops above or underneath compact myelin
Defects in accurate placement of myelin sheath by oligodendrocytes

Role in cell number homeostasis of developing neuroepithelia

Largely nonoverlapping expression of cadm3 and cadm2a in developing retina and spinal cord
Cadm3 binds heterophilically and preferentially to cadm4

biological.summary: CADM3 identified as a novel gene involved in the pathogenesis of hereditary motor neuropathies (HMN) through whole exome and genome sequencing. Discovery demonstrates CADM3's role in motor neuron disease mechanisms and axonal degeneration.

biological.citation: Necl-1/CADM3 regulates cone synapse formation in the mouse retina (PMID: 38623325)
biological.summary: CADM3/Necl-1 localizes to cone photoreceptors and type 4 OFF cone bipolar cells. In Necl-1-/- mice, cone synapses are dislocated, AMPA receptors are mislocalized, and optokinetic responses are impaired, indicating CADM3 regulates cone synapse formation and short-wavelength light signal transmission.

biological.citation: Clinical significance of low expression of CADM3 in breast cancer and preliminary exploration of related mechanisms (PMID: 38515057)
biological.summary: CADM3 expression is significantly lower in breast cancer tissues than adjacent normal tissues. High CADM3 expression correlates with better prognosis and is associated with reduced cell proliferation and migration. CADM3 negatively regulates MAPK pathway activation, inhibiting phosphorylation of ERK1/2 and JNK1.

biological.citation: Differential Contribution of Cadm1-Cadm3 Cell Adhesion Molecules to Peripheral Myelinated Axons (PMID: 33397712)
biological.summary: CADM3 is identified as the main axonal ligand for glial CADM4 in peripheral myelinated axons. Cadm3-/- mice show abnormal distribution of Caspr and Kv1 channels. CADM3 functions in a hierarchical adhesion code with CADM1 and CADM2 to mediate axon-glia interactions essential for myelination.

biological.citation: miR-140-5p suppresses retinoblastoma cell proliferation, migration, and invasion by targeting CEMIP and CADM3 (PMID: 29808799)
biological.summary: CADM3 expression is increased in retinoblastoma tissues and cell lines. miR-140-5p negatively regulates CADM3 expression by targeting its 3'-UTR. CADM3 overexpression promotes cell proliferation, migration, and invasion in RB cells.

biological.citation: Circ004463 promotes fibroblast proliferation and collagen I synthesis by sponging miR-23b and regulating CADM3/MAP4K4 via activation of AKT/ERK pathways (PMID: 36502948)
biological.summary: CADM3 is a downstream target of the circ0044633-miR-23b axis in fibroblasts. CADM3 regulates fibroblast proliferation and collagen I synthesis through activation of AKT and ERK pathways. CADM3 overexpression increases skin thickness and collagen content in vivo.
biological.sample_size: In vitro fibroblast studies; in vivo mouse skin model

biological.citation: GRIK5 stimulates colon cancer growth and metastasis through cAMP/PKA/CADM3 signaling (PMID: 36959746)
biological.summary: CADM3 is a downstream effector of GRIK5-induced cAMP/PKA signaling in colon cancer. GRIK5 overexpression increases CADM3 expression, promoting tumor growth and metastasis. Higher GRIK5 levels correlate with poor overall survival in colon cancer patients.
biological.sample_size: 398 colon cancer patients from TCGA; 26 clinical colon cancer patients; HCT116 and CT26 cell lines

biological.citation: Peptidomic analysis of CSF reveals new biomarker candidates for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (PMID: 40681694)
biological.summary: CADM3-derived peptides are significantly downregulated in cerebrospinal fluid of ALS patients compared to controls. CADM3 peptides are part of an 8-peptide biomarker panel that discriminates ALS from controls with 98% AUC and are not changed in other neurodegenerative diseases.
biological.sample_size: Discovery cohort n=48; validation cohort n=109

biological.citation: ASHG 2019 - Mutation in CADM3 cause upper limb predominant neuropathy with pyramidal signs (A.P. Rebelo et al.)
biological.summary: CADM3 Tyr172Cys mutation identified in three families with axonal CMT2 and upper limb-predominant motor neuropathy with pyramidal signs. The mutation creates a novel disulfide bond, alters protein conformation, increases ER retention, and reduces co-localization with CADM4 at the plasma membrane, disrupting axon-glial interactions.

biological.citation: Using Machine Learning Methods to Study Colorectal Cancer Tumor Micro-Environment and Its Biomarkers (PMID: 37446311)
biological.summary: CADM3 identified as one of five significant biomarkers for colorectal cancer prognosis through machine learning analysis of TCGA and GEO RNA-seq data. CADM3 expression is significantly correlated with CRC patient survival and immune cell infiltration.
